title: Chapter 43: The Man Named
content:
Chapter 43: The Man Named

Wu Qing led the Zerg army to the tall city gate of Tiger City. Through the open gate, he saw a group of amazing tiger cavalry rushing over.

At the front of the tiger cavalry team is an extraordinarily tall and mighty tiger knight. He is wearing a red cloak. On top of his colorful tiger head, the word "king" is particularly obvious on his forehead.

Before the people arrive, the sound comes first.

"The respected Lord of Great Xia is here! 'Meng' is late to greet you! Please forgive me!"

Search TWKAN on GOOGLE

The voice was loud and clear, with a sense of power and a faint sense of vicissitudes of life.

"This is our Lord!"

The tiger knight who was leading the way beside Wu Qing introduced him to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing could tell that this tiger knight had a heartfelt respect for their lord.

Wu Qing didn't yell in response. He didn't have a loud voice like the Tiger Clan. He spurred his horse forward and took a few steps forward.

When the lord who called himself "Meng" came to the city gate and dismounted from his mount, he also turned over and dismounted at the same time.

The two lords greeted each other with smiles on their faces.

"Wu Qing, the Lord of Great Xia, please forgive me for taking the liberty of visiting!"

Wu Qing was the first to speak.

As he got closer, he could see the various scars on the Tiger Lord's head and face, confirming the Tiger Lord's status as a warrior who had fought for the rest of his life.

"Haha! The lords who can personally lead the army at this time! They are all heroes!"

"No matter what it is, it's worth making friends with!"

The huge figure of the Tiger Lord, nearly three meters tall, opened his arms enthusiastically, wanting to give Wu Qing a hug.

The insect substitute that was hatched based on Wu Qing's actual height was less than 1.9 meters tall. The difference in body shape between the two was too obvious.

The Lord of the Tiger Territory was happy for a moment, but when he opened his arms out of habit, he discovered this problem and felt a little embarrassed.

Wu Qing smiled calmly, and the biological reproductive equipment on his body multiplied instantly, covering and changing his height and body shape. At this time, it seemed very natural to hug the Lord of the Tiger Territory.

"Haha! I was so happy that I forgot about your identity as a human being. I didn't expect you to have such a magical armor!"

The two hugged each other warmly.

Hug ceremony, in this world, is the etiquette when close people meet. The Tiger Territory lord greeted him with a hug ceremony, which shows that he has a certain understanding of Wu Qing's Daxia Territory and the Zerg.

Wu Qing did not restrict the scouts in these territories, and this move now came into effect.

What others see with their own eyes is always much more effective than what you say with your mouth.

With the strength of the Tiger Leader, their scouts must have obtained the most and most detailed information about the surrounding area.

There were several battles between the Zerg and Bugbear clans. It was difficult for them not to know about such big news.

In this situation, a lord who dared to fight against the bugbears alone and defeated them was worthy of everyone's high regard.

"This is just a fancy trick to make up for the shortcomings."

Wu Qing explained that the hug ceremony was completed and he controlled the biological reproductive equipment to return to its original state.

In this world, because there are many races, it is very common for people to have different body shapes, which does not represent their strength or status.

"Let's go! It's getting late, let's go into the city!"

"Enter the city together with the army! We have a spacious barracks to entertain you!"

The Lord of the Tiger Lord waved his hand and personally helped Wu Qing mount his horse, and then led the Tiger Cavalry to clear the way and lead Wu Qing and the Zerg army into the city.

"Confident and generous!"

This time Wu Qing finally saw the true style of a lord in this world.

The respected profession of lord is definitely not like playing house like the little guy from the Tengu clan.

Entering the city, the streets are spacious, with stone buildings on both sides. The style is simple and practical. The living conditions of the people in the territory are obviously much better than those in the red soil territory.

Along the way, the people Wu Qing saw were all races with strong combat capabilities. The potential combat power of this territory should not be underestimated.

Wu Qing took ten insect guards and three one-star hydralisks to the lord's mansion in the center of the city. The insect army went to the camp in the city to settle down.

Wu Qing did not come in person. The Zerg army was accompanied by a host and was not afraid of conspiracy. Even if it was a bloody battle, he would not lose money anyway.

So he acted fearless.

Wu Qing's performance happened to be the type that the Tiger Lord admired, which made the Tiger Lord become more enthusiastic and close to him.

With such a good initial impression, subsequent discussions will be much easier.

The lord's mansion is a large courtyard, which is entirely made of stone. It is tall, simple and solid, very much in line with the style of the Tiger tribe.

The tiger tribe lord brought Wu Qing to a large open-air courtyard, where tables and chairs were set up, and meat was being roasted on several bonfires. The meat was sizzling and oily, and the meat was fragrant.

"Please sit down! Let's talk while we eat!"

The leader of the tiger tribe asked Wu Qing to take a seat, and he also sat down and asked his men to start serving meat.

Plates of cut barbecue were placed in front of Wu Qing, and several large pieces of bone-in meat were placed next to the Tiger Clan lord.

The lord of the tiger tribe grabbed a piece of meat with bones and said, "Eat some first to fill your stomach!", then he ate it in big mouthfuls, including the meat with bones, chewed it, and swallowed it.

Wu Qing was not polite, picked up the meat on the plate and ate it.

There is no difference in body structure between bugmen and humans, and their sense of taste is the same as that of humans. Through the taste of the substitute, Wu Qing can also feel the taste of food.

This meat is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and it tastes really good.

When you eat with people who can eat, if you eat a lot, they will think you are a kindred spirit, which will bring the two sides closer.

Zerg people with Zerg genes have almost no limit to eating, and all substances can be used as energy storage.

If you are afraid of eating too much and wasting, there is also a matter-energy conversion, which can be directly converted into system resources.

In a simple meal, the two lords ate heartily and the guests and hosts were very happy.

When they officially got to the point, the two of them no longer had too many polite words, and communicated like old friends.

"We are both lords, with equal status, you call me 'Meng', and I call you Wu Qing, it's simple and convenient!"

"A single name with the word 'Meng'? This name is very strange, but very vivid."

"Haha, I was indeed very 'Meng', and this name was chosen at that time, and it has been used ever since! This kind of single-word name is the tradition of our clan, and there are not many people who are qualified to take single-word names!"

Speaking of his own name, Meng, the tiger lord, seemed very proud.

Wu Qing could also tell from the details that this tiger warrior had a story, but this story might not be so beautiful.

"I admire you!"

Wu Qing wanted to give Meng a thumbs up, but was afraid that people in this world would not understand and misunderstand him, so he gave up.

"Haha, let's not talk about the past!"
